title: SMProfile-CustomerOrder payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.json 4.2.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

quantity.description: Ordered piece count of the order line (menge). Together with unit_price the source for total_amount — the real ERP does not keep an order total: order value = quantity × unit_price (derived by the it-evaluator).

unit_price.description: Unit price of the order line (stueckpreis). Together with quantity the source for total_amount (= quantity × unit_price).

total_amount.description: Order value. Delivered directly where available; otherwise derived by the it-evaluator as quantity × unit_price (the real ERP has no total column). Driver of the €-impact prioritization (expected_impact).

due_date.description: Customer delivery commitment (the promised date the sales order is due).

status.description: Sales-order status in the B2MML RequestState vocabulary (MESA B2MML, the XML implementation of IEC 62264: B2MML-Common.xsd RequestState1Type); a source maps its own values with valueMap. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, attributes › status › description.

customer_due_date.description: Customer delivery date of the order (moved here from ProductionOrder in core 3.0.0).

article_ref.description: The article the order line is for (FK to Article.article_no).

article_name.description: Name of the ordered article as the ERP prints it on the order.

production_order_ref.description: The production order that makes this order line (FK to ProductionOrder.production_order_no).

parent_order_ref.description: The customer order this one was split from (split order, suffix -S1); empty on an unsplit order.

status_source.description: The ERP's own sales status word, unmapped (status carries it in the B2MML RequestState vocabulary). Values measured over 26 304 orders 19.11.2026.

status_code.description: The ERP's numeric order status code as delivered (order_status). Values measured over 26 304 orders 19.11.2026.

confirmed.description: The order is confirmed to the customer (order confirmation sent).

confirmed_delivery_date.description: Delivery date confirmed to the customer in the order confirmation.

actual_delivery_date.description: Date the order was actually delivered; empty while not delivered.

created_at.description: When the order was created in the ERP.

updated_at.description: When the ERP last changed the order.

closed_at.description: When the ERP closed the order; empty while open.
